answer.rationale: Rollback is excluded because compliance has ruled the security patch must not be reverted. Regional failover is attractive given memory_b2, but moving settlement traffic at peak load while the write path is degraded could amplify pressure on the destination region. Routing read replicas (memory_b5) addresses dashboard/report read load, not write-path p99. Circuit breaker is for dependency outages, not internal write latency. Adding capacity directly absorbs the sustained write load and restores headroom, matching the pattern in memory_b3 where provisioning headroom kept queue depth flat during peak traffic. One small guarded test first to confirm the added capacity takes writes cleanly, then scale.
